clues: Felix topped out at neither 1,000 feet nor 1,200 feet.
Whoever hiked Bramble Hill did not top out at 1,200 feet.
Cass topped out lower than whoever packed the jerky.
Neither Felix nor Enzo packed the figs.
The hiker with the trail mix topped out exactly 200 feet above the hiker with the jerky.
Of Wren and Enzo, one topped out at 1,400 feet and the other at 1,200 feet.
The hiker on Fiddler Hill topped out exactly 400 feet higher than Cass.
Crow's Nest was climbed by neither Felix nor Enzo.
Neither Enzo nor Cass topped out at 1,400 feet.
hints: Look at clue 6. Wren and Enzo share 1,400 feet and 1,200 feet. Is there a clue that keeps one of them off the top?
Two clues together. Clue 9 keeps Enzo off 1,400 feet, so put it beside clue 6. Then read clue 1 for Felix.
So Wren topped out at 1,400 feet and Enzo at 1,200. Clue 1 leaves Felix only 800 feet, so Cass topped out at 1,000.
Clue 3 puts the jerky above Cass's 1,000 feet, and clue 5 needs the trail mix 200 feet higher still. So Enzo packed jerky and Wren trail mix.

solution.key_idea: Clue 9 keeps Enzo off 1,400 feet, so clue 6 puts Wren at the top and Enzo at 1,200.
steps: By clue 6, Wren and Enzo hold 1,400 and 1,200 feet. Clue 9 keeps Enzo off 1,400, so Enzo topped out at 1,200 and Wren at 1,400.
Clue 1 rules out 1,000 and 1,200 feet for Felix, so Felix topped out at 800 feet and Cass at 1,000.
Clue 3 puts the jerky above Cass's 1,000 feet, and clue 5 puts the trail mix 200 feet higher. So Enzo packed jerky and Wren trail mix.
Clue 4 says neither Felix nor Enzo packed the figs, so Cass did, and Felix packed the cheese.
By clue 7, the Fiddler Hill hiker topped out 400 feet above Cass's 1,000, at 1,400 feet. So Wren climbed Fiddler Hill.
Clue 8 keeps Felix and Enzo off Crow's Nest, and Wren is on Fiddler Hill, so Cass climbed Crow's Nest.
Clue 2 keeps Bramble Hill off 1,200 feet, so Felix climbed Bramble Hill and Enzo climbed Thimble Knob.
solution.epilogue: That evening the logbook got its names: Felix on Bramble Hill, Cass on Crow's Nest, Enzo on Thimble Knob and Wren on Fiddler Hill. Felix called it shipshape.
